prepared_for: Magali Rady, Jad Chbeir and the YKONE Middle East team
running: YKONE × NOYA · Egypt for YKONE’s clients
title: Your brief. *Egypt, brought to life.*
positioning: YKONE brings the vision and the client brief. NOYA brings the Egypt side to life: the places, the hospitality and the people on the ground, under YKONE’s name.

why: The Longines Global Champions Tour opens a five-year run at the Pyramids (22–24 October), Forever Is Now returns to the plateau (4–28 November) and Shakira plays Giza on 28 November.
The museum marks its first year on 5 November with Gala de Danza, the company’s first performance in the Middle East.
The Cairo International Film Festival (11–20 November) draws film talent and press to the city.

blocks.label: Where NOYA fits
blocks.title: One partner on the ground, *for every format.*

items.title: Brand campaigns and shoots
items.text: Locations, permits with our local partners, crew coordination and hospitality from recce to wrap.

items.title: Creator trips
items.text: Arrivals, stays, movement and hosting for creators, with content windows planned around the light.

items.title: Dinners and experiences
items.text: Venues, tables, hospitality and service at Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum, Cairo, Luxor or the Red Sea.

items.title: Launches and press trips
items.text: Guest programmes, transfers, dining and on-the-ground management for press and clients.

items.title: VIP and talent movement
items.text: Airport reception, chauffeurs and security for talent and principals.

items.title: Boats, beaches and villas
items.text: Yachts, beach settings and private villas on the Red Sea and the North Coast.

blocks.label: An example evening
blocks.title: A brand dinner at Giza
rows: A terrace facing the Pyramids, or an evening at the Grand Egyptian Museum.
Guests collected from their hotels at sunset and met by a NOYA host.
One long table in low light, dressed to YKONE’s creative direction.
A short private introduction to the site by an Egyptologist before dinner.
Modern Egyptian, served to share; the menu is created with the chef once the venue is set.
A keepsake chosen with the brand at each place.
Chauffeured returns, or a late drink at the hotel.
blocks.note: An illustration of what NOYA prepares on the ground, not a confirmed programme. Venues, access and dates are subject to permits, approvals and availability. NOYA confirms each before anything is presented to a client.
